{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of things named after [[Wacław Sierpiński]] (1882–1969), a Polish mathematician known especially for his contributions to [[set theory]], [[number theory]], theory of [[Function (mathematics)|functions]], and [[topology]]:

{{tocright}}
==Mathematics==
*[[Sierpiński triangle]]

*[[Sierpiński carpet]]
*[[Sierpiński's constant]]
*[[Sierpiński cube]]
*[[Sierpiński curve]]
*[[Sierpiński game]]
*[[Sierpiński graph]]
*[[Sierpiński number]]
*[[Sierpiński set]]
*[[Sierpiński space]]
*[[Sierpiński's theorem on metric spaces]]
*[[Sierpiński number#Sierpiński problem|Sierpiński problem]]
*[[Sierpiński number#Sierpiński problem|Prime Sierpiński problem]]
*[[Sierpiński number#Sierpiński problem|Extended Sierpiński problem]]
*[[Sierpiński number#Simultaneously Sierpiński and Riesel|Sierpiński-Riesel problem]]
